name: krawings-cooktimer
description: Capacitor wrapper (appId de.krawings.cooktimer) around https://portal.krawings.de/cooktimer — the KDS Cooking Timer station board. Built by .github/workflows/build-cooktimer.yml, which runs Capacitor with this folder as its CWD and resolves @capacitor/* from the repo-root node_modules. The android/ project is generated per build and gitignored.
